zh: 家庭财务记账升级为纯原生通信与快速环境预检：重构底层通信架构彻底去除 Python 依赖，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux 原生运行；增加 2.5 秒快速网络与保险箱 API Key 预检，杜绝失败时无谓执行终端命令行探测。
Open-AutoGLM 手机端控制增加服务连通性预检与防刷约束：新增 2.5 秒端口存活探测与鉴权检查，服务端未就绪时直接向用户输出诊断指引，严禁模型在终端执行网络或进程命令探测。
微信本地库查询技能新增操作系统与解密库环境预检：仅限 macOS 宿主机且本地解密库目录就绪时启用，非 macOS 或目录缺失环境下自动停用并给出清晰状态说明，避免无意义的命令行报错。
en: Family Finance Bookkeeper upgraded to 100% native Node.js API with fast preflight check: completely eliminated Python dependency for cross-platform compatibility on Windows/macOS/Linux, added 2.5s connectivity probe and Vault API key check to prevent terminal command probing loops.

Open-AutoGLM mobile control enhanced with fast preflight connectivity validation: added 2.5s port health probe and authentication verification, outputting direct diagnostic instructions and preventing runaway command diagnostics when offline.

WeChat Vault skill updated with OS and decrypted database directory prerequisites: strictly enabled only on macOS hosts with local vault directories mounted, automatically disabled with clear diagnostic status on non-macOS environments.
